summary: As CDAO leaders, we often see enthusiasm for big outcomes, however foundational investments necessary may not receive the same support. This discussion will focus on ways you have found success in your organizations to prioritize and advocate for essential, long-term investments. Join this interactive discussion to share your experiences, strategies, and co-create actionable solutions. Through active participation, we’ll develop practical next steps and tools to link investments to outcomes and drive organizational alignment. To help us kickstart an engaging discussion, please reflect on the questions below before the session. Your insights will shape our conversation, and you’ll receive a customized resource afterward to support your continued success.
